title: find_data_domains input
description: Which data domains match, and who owns them? Lists the business data tree (C49) with each domain's path, level, effective classification, owner, deputy and steward (own or inherited from a domain above), the three handling rules with where each is set, the counts of mappings, uses and open decisions, and the owner gaps. Writes nothing.

text.description: Words that must appear in the label, the path or the examples.

classificationKeys.description: Only domains whose effective classification is one of these.

ownerObjectId.description: Only domains whose effective data owner, deputy or data steward is this person.

gapsOnly.description: Only domains with an owner gap (DC-01 to DC-04).
